findings.reason: Untrusted source: userspace-supplied MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE generic-netlink doit message (registered drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c:605-610 with .flags = GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM and .validate = GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT|GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_DUMP), so the attribute presence set is fully attacker-chosen and only uns-admin (user-namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN) reachable. Violated validated-equals-used invariant: the presence guard at lines 421-423 in hwsim_new_edge_nl() joins the two negated presence tests with && instead of ||, so it rejects only when BOTH MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID and MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE are absent; a message carrying RADIO_EDGE but omitting RADIO_ID passes validation with info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID] == NULL. The family policy hwsim_genl_policy (lines 579-583) types RADIO_ID as plain { .type = NLA_U32 } and RADIO_EDGE as plain { .type = NLA_NESTED } with no required/validation_data coverage, and the op sets GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT, so the genl core never enforces RADIO_ID presence — no other check covers that exact index. Unsafe use for THIS branch: line 431 'v0 = nla_get_u32(info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID]);' dereferences the NULL slot (nla_get_u32 reads *(u32 *)nla_data(NULL), i.e. offset NLA_HDRLEN from NULL) -> NULL-pointer-dereference oops from the attacker-crafted NEW_EDGE message. The sibling slot is equally uncovered: line 425 passes info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE] (NULL when only RADIO_ID is omitted) straight into nla_parse_nested_deprecated, which dereferences it via nla_len()/nla_data() (that nested-parse aspect is the same defect already recorded by intents i010/i012; the nla_get_u32(RADIO_ID) use at 431 is the distinct unchecked-tb-deref instance reported here). Counterevidence checked: the corrected sibling hwsim_del_edge_nl (the seed instance, lines 476-494) uses '||' at lines 483-484 and checks edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID] at 490 before uses at 493-494, showing the required idiom; no intervening check exists between the guard at 421-423 and the uses at 425/431. Consequence: local DoS (kernel NULL-deref oops) from unprivileged-user-namespace-reachable netlink input; no privilege-escalation path demonstrated.

Untrusted source: userspace-supplied MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_SET_EDGE generic-netlink doit message (registered at lines 617-622 with .flags = GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM, GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT|GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_DUMP). Violated invariant (validated != used): hwsim_set_edge_lqi() has TWO unchecked-slot dereferences of the same mechanism. (1) Outer: the guard at lines 531-533 is the &&-joined negated-presence form, so a message carrying MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE but omitting MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID passes with info->attrs[RADIO_ID] == NULL (hwsim_genl_policy lines 580-581 type it plain NLA_U32, not required), and line 542 'v0 = nla_get_u32(info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID]);' dereferences the NULL slot; symmetrically, a message carrying RADIO_ID but omitting RADIO_EDGE passes the guard and line 535 feeds the NULL RADIO_EDGE slot to nla_parse_nested_deprecated (nested-parse aspect already recorded by i010/i012). (2) Inner: even when both outer attributes are present, the second guard at lines 538-540 is again &&-joined over edge_attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_EDGE_ATTR_ENDPOINT_ID] and edge_attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_EDGE_ATTR_LQI], so a nested RADIO_EDGE payload containing exactly one of them passes, and lines 543-544 unconditionally dereference BOTH slots via nla_get_u32/nla_get_u8 — e.g. a message with ENDPOINT_ID present and LQI absent gives nla_get_u8(edge_attrs[LQI]) == nla_get_u8(NULL), a second NULL-deref instance inside the same function that no other intent recorded. Unsafe use: each of lines 542, 543, 544 can dereference a slot whose presence was never proven (outer policy non-required; inner hwsim_edge_policy likewise does not mark ENDPOINT_ID/LQI required). Counterevidence checked: the seed-fixed sibling hwsim_del_edge_nl uses '||' at 483-484 and a single-attr check at 490; hwsim_get_radio_nl (299-301) and hwsim_del_radio_nl (187-190) use correct single-attribute presence checks. Consequence: kernel NULL-pointer-dereference oops (local DoS) from unprivileged-user-namespace-reachable genl input; runtime reproduction not performed.

candidates.reason: hwsim_new_edge_nl: nla_get_u32(info->attrs[RADIO_ID]) at 431 has no covering check — the only guard (421-423) is the &&-inverted presence test and the policy entry (580) is plain NLA_U32, non-required; a NEW_EDGE message with RADIO_EDGE present and RADIO_ID absent passes and crashes at 431.

hwsim_set_edge_lqi: nla_get_u32(info->attrs[RADIO_ID]) at 542 uncovered by the inverted && guard (531-533); plus the inner && guard (538-540) leaves edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID] (543) and edge_attrs[LQI] (544) dereferenceable while absent.
hwsim_del_edge_nl is the seed instance (never reportable); in this snapshot it already uses the corrected '||' guard at 483-484 and checks edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID] at 490 before uses at 493-494.
hwsim_del_radio_nl checks !attrs[RADIO_ID] (187-188) before nla_get_u32 at 190; hwsim_get_radio_nl likewise at 299-301 — correct single-attribute guards.

ctrl_getfamily: FAMILY_ID and FAMILY_NAME reads at 1032/1040 are each inside if (info->attrs[...]) branches; policy CTRL_ATTR_FAMILY_ID U16 / NAME NUL_STRING with GENL_NAMSIZ-1 len.
parse_nl_config wraps every consumed attr (LOCATOR/LOCATOR_MATCH/CSUM_MODE/IDENT_TYPE/IFINDEX) in its own if (info->attrs[...]) before nla_get_u64/u8/s32.

limitations: Coverage of the direct-deref surface is bounded to handlers where nla_get_*/nla_data/nla_len/nested-parse is applied directly to an info->attrs[N] slot (653 raw hits ranked and triaged; the highest-density files were read function-by-function); attribute values that first pass through intermediate locals or helpers were followed only in the files read.

net/wireless/nl80211.c (140 nla_get + 185 nla_data hits) was only spot-checked in this session (aided by the f010 audit of its post/pre_doit user_ptr plumbing); a per-handler line-by-line pass over every nl80211 doit was not completed within this intent's budget, so an unchecked slot inside a rarely-used nl80211 command cannot be excluded.

tb[]/data[]-local dereferences inside rtnetlink RTM_* doit/changelink/fdb handlers belong to the i013 branch and were enumerated there, not re-audited here; net/sched, net/ipv4, net/ipv6, net/decnet, and net/dcb rtnl handlers remain enumerated-but-not-deep-read in this branch.

No compilation or runtime reproducer was executed (the snapshot tree is read-only and has no top-level Kconfig/Makefile); the NULL-deref conclusions rest on reading the guard, the non-required nla_policy entries (hwsim_genl_policy 579-583), the GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT op flags, and nla_get_u32/nla_parse_nested_deprecated semantics (include/net/netlink.h reads through nla_data()).

Reachability requires the mac802154_hwsim module to be loaded (or module-autoload available); the ops carry GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM, satisfiable from an unprivileged user namespace, but no live exploit was attempted; impact is characterized as local DoS (kernel oops), with no privilege-escalation path demonstrated.

Both reported findings share the same underlying inverted-guard defect in functions whose nested-parse (NULL-argument) aspect was already reported by sibling intents i010/i012; the finding entries here emphasize the distinct unchecked-tb-deref uses (nla_get_u32 on the uncovered attrs[RADIO_ID] slots and nla_get_u32/nla_get_u8 on the uncovered edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID]/[LQI] slots) that no prior intent recorded.
